title: Alex Chesterman's Smaller Plan for Cazoo, and the Collapse After It
conflicts: Listing valuation: about $7bn (MoneyWeek, Fortune, BusinessCloud, CarsVansandBikes) vs $8bn at the $10 listing price (City AM) vs about £5bn (PA) vs over £6.3bn (Euronews); the story gives $7bn and City AM's $8bn. Share fall by January 2023: 93% in a year (Sharecast, City AM) vs about 98% from the 2021 high (BusinessCloud) vs 97% (Telegraph headline, not loadable); story uses 93% in a year. Europe job cuts: 750 (City AM) vs 'hundreds' (Sharecast); story says about 750.
notes: Chesterman left the board in December 2023, five months before the May 2024 administration, so the episode is his January 2023 reset and step-down, with the collapse as its aftermath; no public comment by him on the collapse was found. A 'made mistakes along the way' quote attributed to him in search summaries is actually Paul Whitehead's (BusinessCloud) and is not used. Critics' blame (dealers, commentators) is left out; no court or regulator has assigned blame.
